results.term_definition: An astronaut is a person who is qualified to be part of a crew onboard a space flight. Astronauts are trained in the operation of rockets, space stations, and to solve specialized technical problems that are unique to trips outside Earth's atmosphere. They are often trained to carry out science experiments in space. A few astronauts have even walked on the Moon. Astronaut was originally used to refer to space crews from the United States of America but is now a general term used by many different countries. Russian space crew are called cosmonauts, Chinese space crew are often called taikonauts, and European space crew are called spationauts.
